# GeneralPedia.com

> The Premier Everyday Knowledge Hub & Comprehensive Digital Encyclopedia

## Overview
GeneralPedia provides verified, in-depth informational articles, financial calculators, tax rate guides, medical symptom analysis, automotive reviews, and actionable how-to tutorials.

## Categories
- [How-To & Guides](https://generalpedia.com/how-to): Practical guides, everyday problem-solving, and explanations.
- [Finance & Money](https://generalpedia.com/finance): Federal tax brackets, Roth IRA contribution limits, 401(k), and loan calculators.
- [Health & Wellness](https://generalpedia.com/health): Medically referenced symptom breakdowns, sinus care, and natural remedies.
- [Calculators & Tools](https://generalpedia.com/tools): Interactive calculators, unit converters (oz to gallon), and calendars.
- [Automotive](https://generalpedia.com/automotive): Vehicle maintenance, used car valuation, and hybrid specs (Toyota Camry).
- [Tech & Digital](https://generalpedia.com/tech): Cybersecurity concepts, software algorithms, and hardware fundamentals.
- [Home & Lifestyle](https://generalpedia.com/lifestyle): Home safety, dryer vent fire prevention, and pet nutrition.
- [Entertainment & Culture](https://generalpedia.com/culture): Olympic games, major world sporting events, and cultural analyses.
